home.profileBody: This is your name and level (or guest mode). EXP points appear once you are signed in.
home.navBody: Open Home, Learn 4 skills, Practice tests, and Ranking from the left sidebar.
home.greetingBody: See today’s date, practice progress, study streak, and your rank at the top of the page.
home.heroBody: The WEWIN mascot welcomes you. Jump into lessons or practice tests to begin.
home.continueBody: Pick up an in-progress test, and check your stats and ranking points.
home.skillsBody: Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking — learn with video lessons, then practise.
home.recommendedBody: Choose a matching test to practise. The leaderboard sits in the right-hand column.

learn.headerBody: Each course has its own progress. Pick one to study all four IELTS skills.
learn.coursesBody: See lesson counts and completion, then open a course to start.
learn.navBody: Use the left menu to switch to Home, Practice tests, or Ranking.

learnCourse.headerBody: These are the four skills in this course. Open a skill to see its lessons.
learnCourse.progressBody: Track completed lessons. Each lesson unlocks after you finish its exercises.
learnCourse.skillsBody: Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking — tap a card to keep learning.

learnSkill.headerBody: Watch the video, then complete the short exercises. Finish to unlock the next lesson.
learnSkill.progressBody: This bar shows how many lessons you have finished in the current skill.
learnSkill.lessonsBody: Lessons unlock in order. Open an unlocked lesson to watch and practise.

tests.headerBody: Browse Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking tests. Open one to review details and start.
tests.filtersBody: Search by name, or filter by skill and tag to find the right paper.
tests.catalogBody: Each card is a test. Open details to choose practice or full-exam mode.

testDetail.infoBody: See time limit, parts, description, and your attempt history for this test.
testDetail.startBody: Choose section practice or a full exam, set a timer, then press start.
testDetail.historyBody: Review submitted attempts, scores, and reopen a paper to study answers.

ranking.headerBody: Filter by day, week, month, or all time. Points come from submitted Listening and Reading tests.
ranking.podiumBody: The three leading learners this period. Practise regularly to climb!
ranking.youBody: The bottom bar always shows your rank and points (or a sign-in prompt).

attempts.headerBody: Every practice and full-exam attempt is saved here.
attempts.listBody: Check scores, time, and reopen a test to review answers.
